To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the proposed noninvasive glucose monitoring system can be used as a tool to measure the glucose levels in blood.
the resonant frequency of an antenna wrapped around a human hand can be used as a measure for blood glucose level.
a wrist cuff antenna can be used for blood glucose sensing and the frequency shift of the antenna input impedance is related to the dielectric properties and hence the glucose levels of the blood.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a non-invasive blood-glucose monitoring system based on a novel antenna design and a tissue characterization technique, which is capable of monitoring blood glucose levels in real-time.
the development of an antenna for a non-invasive blood monitoring system.
a non invasive blood monitoring technique using a cuff wrapped around the wrist and a resonant antenna inside the cuff.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the technique is feasible and the results obtained are promising.
the feasibility of a blood glucose monitoring system has been demonstrated using the antenna based technique.
the non invasive blood glucose measurement system using a wrist-worn antenna is a promising technique for the future.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed technique is feasible and can be developed to be a practical non invasive blood glucose monitor.
we have demonstrated that it is feasible to monitor the glucose level in a human wrist using a non invasive method.
the feasibility of a wrist-worn antenna for non-invasive glucose monitoring has been demonstrated.

it is possible to obtain an accurate estimation of blood glucose levels using the proposed system.
the resonant frequency is sensitive to the glucose levels in the blood.
